svg.text: Monstrous Moonshine · Sum-of-Divisors (σ₁) Prime Shells, Folded
The same eleven McKay–Thompson series, but each bead is a brand-new prime of the DIVISOR SUM σ₁ of a coefficient — the
“sum-of-divisors series” that launched the project. Rings = q-grade n; each prime drawn ONCE on its global first-appearance ring.
ring = q-grade where the prime FIRST
appears in ANY series' σ₁ value;
striped by every series that needs it.
62 distinct primes in the folded σ₁ series, de-duplicated; 140 distinct coefficient values, each σ₁ computed multiplicatively from its factorisation.
Machine-checked in Lean 4 / Mathlib (RequestProject/MoonshineFoldSigma.lean: folded_sigma_shells, foldSigma_sigma_correct, no_amicable_fold) — no sorry, standard axioms only.
